title: Deep Predictive Learning with Proprioceptive and Visual Attention for Humanoid Robot Repositioning Assistance
title_zh: 基于本体感觉与视觉注意力深度预测学习的人形机器人翻身辅助
abstract: Caregiving is a vital role for domestic robots, especially the repositioning care has immense societal value, critically improving the health and quality of life of individuals with limited mobility. However, repositioning task is a challenging area of research, as it requires robots to adapt their motions while interacting flexibly with patients. The task involves several key challenges: (1) applying appropriate force to specific target areas; (2) performing multiple actions seamlessly, each requiring different force application policies; and (3) motion adaptation under uncertain positional conditions. To address these, we propose a deep neural network (DNN)-based architecture utilizing proprioceptive and visual attention mechanisms, along with impedance control to regulate the robot's movements. Using the dual-arm humanoid robot Dry-AIREC, the proposed model successfully generated motions to insert the robot's hand between the bed and a mannequin's back without applying excessive force, and it supported the transition from a supine to a lifted-up position. The project page is here: https://sites.google.com/view/caregiving-robot-airec/repositioning
abstract_zh: 护理是家用机器人的重要角色，尤其是翻身护理具有巨大的社会价值，能显著改善行动不便个体的健康和生活质量。然而，翻身任务是一个具有挑战性的研究领域，因为它要求机器人在与患者灵活交互的同时调整其动作。该任务涉及几个关键挑战：(1) 向特定目标区域施加适当的力；(2) 无缝执行多个动作，每个动作需要不同的力施加策略；(3) 在不确定的位置条件下进行运动适应。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于深度神经网络（DNN）的架构，利用本体感觉和视觉注意力机制，并结合阻抗控制来调节机器人的运动。使用双臂人形机器人Dry-AIREC，所提出的模型成功生成了将机器人的手插入床和人体模型背部之间而不施加过大力度的运动，并支持从仰卧位到抬起位置的过渡。项目页面见：https://sites.google.com/view/caregiving-robot-airec/repositioning
tldr_zh: 深度预测学习结合注意力与阻抗控制，实现人形机器人安全翻身辅助。
cover_zh: 机器人也能温柔翻身？视觉注意力+阻抗控制，护理不再难！
